source.name: Lucas's AltStore Gallery
source.subtitle: AltGallery plus Lucas's own picks
source.description: A personal AltStore source. It mirrors the AltGallery list (https://github.com/bebound/AltGallery) and adds apps chosen by Lucas, each built from its GitHub Releases.

app.name: GestaltX
app.subtitle: MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27
app.localizedDescription:
A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad, with region-code tweaks, device presets, a CacheExtra field editor, automatic backups and per-preset restore.

On-device MobileGestalt access requires iOS / iPadOS 27.x; on iOS 26.x only local plist editing works.

This source installs builds from Lucas04-nhr/GestaltX, which rebuilds each upstream release with the App Group entitlement embedded, so SideStore and AltStore can set up the App Group themselves. When re-signing with another tool, keep the share extension and give the app and the extension the same App Group.

For security research and educational purposes only. Use it only on devices you own or are authorized to manage.

app.name: LiveContainer
app.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them!
app.localizedDescription:
Run iOS apps without actually installing them!

This is the standalone build, without the built-in SideStore. Install it with AltStore, SideStore or another signer, and refresh it from there.

app.name: Ksign

app.localizedDescription: The "cleaner" ESign app: sign and install IPAs on the device with your own certificate, no computer needed.

app.name: PPSSPP
app.subtitle: PSP emulator
app.localizedDescription: A cross-platform PSP emulator written in C++. See https://ppsspp.org for the full changelog.

app.name: Provenance
app.subtitle: Multi-system emulator frontend
app.localizedDescription:
An iOS and tvOS multi-emulator frontend supporting various Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony console systems.

Each download is about 1 GB. Get started with the wiki at https://wiki.provenance-emu.com.
